class.name: VECSObserver
class.brief_description: A reactive, event-driven observer that reacts to component changes.
class.description:
[b]VECSObserver[/b] subscribes to ECS events (component ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED, membership MATCHED / UNMATCHED, and custom events). When a matching event fires, the observer's callback runs — GDScript observers override [method _script_each], C++ observers override [code]_each[/code].
Subscribe to event kinds by calling the [code]on_*[/code] helpers (e.g. [method on_added]) or by setting [member events] as a bitmask. Filter by component type with [method set_components]; for MATCHED/UNMATCHED use [method set_match_components]. Register the observer with [method VECSWorld.add_observer].

method.name: _script_each
method.description: GDScript override point, called for every subscribed event. [param event] is one of the [enum Event] values, [param entity] is the affected entity, [param payload] carries event-specific data (custom payloads, or empty for component events).

method.name: get_components
method.description: Returns the component filter set with [method set_components].

method.name: get_match_components
method.description: Returns the membership query set with [method set_match_components].

method.name: get_world
method.description: Returns the [VECSWorld] this observer is attached to.

method.name: on_added
method.description: Subscribes to ADDED events (a component was attached to an entity).

method.name: on_changed
method.description: Subscribes to CHANGED events (a component value was written).

method.name: on_custom
method.description: Subscribes to custom events broadcast with [method VECSWorld.emit_event]. Combine with [member custom_event_name] to filter by event name.

method.name: on_matched
method.description: Subscribes to MATCHED events (an entity entered the membership query set with [method set_match_components]).

method.name: on_removed
method.description: Subscribes to REMOVED events (a component was detached or an entity was destroyed).

method.name: on_unmatched
method.description: Subscribes to UNMATCHED events (an entity left the membership query set).

method.name: set_components
method.description: Restricts the observer to events about the named components. Empty means "watch all components".

method.name: set_match_components
method.description: Sets the component-set query for MATCHED / UNMATCHED membership events. The observer tracks which entities match the set and reports transitions.

members.member: When subscribing to custom events, only events with this name are delivered. Empty means all custom events.
Bitmask of subscribed event kinds (the [enum Event] values as bits). Set it directly or use the [code]on_*[/code] helpers.
[constant PER_CALLBACK] runs a callback right after each event; [constant MANUAL] defers the callback until the user triggers it.

constants.constant: A component was added to an entity.
A component was removed from an entity, or the entity was destroyed.
An entity started matching the membership query.
An entity stopped matching the membership query.
A custom event was broadcast with [method VECSWorld.emit_event].
Deliver the callback immediately when the event fires.
Defer delivery until the user triggers it.
